description.value: The Historic Dewdney Pub — also known as the Church of the Blues — is a genuine roadhouse operating inside a 1912 Anglican church building along the Dewdney slough, just off scenic Highway 7 east of Mission in the Fraser Valley. The pub is recognized as one of Canada's top 35 blues clubs, drawing locals and road-trippers alike for its legendary Sunday blues jams, live music events, and large patio with mountain views. An on-site full-service liquor store stocks beer, wine, spirits, and ciders, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to resupply.

address.value: 8793 River Road South, Dewdney, BC V0M 1H0
